title: Patents (General Procedures) (Amendment) Administrative Instructions No. 5 of 2006
text:
Patents 1
BELIZE:
ADMINISTRATIVE INSTRUCTIONS
No. 5 of 2006
ADMINISTRATIVE INSTRUCTIONS made by the Registrar of Intellectual
Property in exercise of the powers conferred upon him by section 69 of the
Patents Act, Chapter 253 of the Substantive Laws of Belize, Revised Edition
2000.
Short title. 1. These Administrative Instructions may be cited as the
PATENTS (GENERAL PROCEDURES) (AMENDMENT)
ADMINISTRATIVE INSTRUCTIONS, 2006,
A.I. No. 2 and shall be read and construed as one with the Patents (General Procedures)
of 2005.
Administrative Instructions, which, as amended, are hereinafter referred to as the
principal Administrative Instructions.
Amendment 2. Schedule I to the principal Administrative Instructions is amended by
of Schedule I.
adding the following fees -
“On application for amendment to any other application .............. 50.00
On submitting a withdrawal of application …………….. ………50.00
On submitting a notice of opposition to an application
for a surrender of a patent ………………………………………100.00
For participating in opposition and revocation proceedings……..350.00 ”.
Amendment 3. Schedule II to the principal Administrative Instructions is amended by
of Schedule
II. adding Form No. 16 outlined in the Schedule to these Administrative Instructions.

Patents 2
MADE by the Registrar of Intellectual Property this 5th day of May, 2006.
____________________________
(ALHAJI TEJAN-COLE)
DEPUTY REGISTRAR OF INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
